_populated_for: TESTS DIRECTION MATH. 2 frames, vector dot product against an allowed direction. Traffic domain.
name: wrong_way
description: Emit when a tracked vehicle moves against the permitted direction of travel.
rule: For each vehicle present in both frames, compute the movement vector of its box centre; if the dot product of that vector with the allowed direction is negative and the movement magnitude exceeds min_movement_x1000 thousandths, emit a violation.
